title: fix(plugin-kanban): the board's drag live region names the card and the column, not their ids (objectui#12716)
body:
Fixes #12716
Clause-②: no

## What changed

The kanban board's `DndContext` passed no `accessibility` announcements, so dnd-kit read its default English sentences, which name the dragged card and its target by their ids: a card's id is its record id and a column's id is the grouped field's option value. The board now passes `accessibility={{ announcements }}`, built by one module-local helper beside it, `packages/plugin-kanban/src/kanbanDndAnnouncements.ts`, after the form designer's `formDndAnnouncements.ts` (objectui#11802).

- The helper resolves the active and over ids the way the board's `handleDragEnd` resolves them (a card id first, then a column id), so the column a sentence names is the column a drop there lands in. It covers pick-up, over (a card, a column, nothing), drop (moved, or nothing moved) and cancel.
- Every sentence is one key under `kanban.dnd` in all ten `packages/i18n` bundles, read through the translation the board already builds (`createSafeTranslation`), with the names interpolated so a language orders them as it needs. The board's provider-less defaults table carries the same English, so a board with no translation provider never reads a raw key.
- No id reaches a sentence. A card or column with a blank title, or one the board no longer holds, is named by a neutral phrase from the same packs ("an untitled card", "an unnamed column").
- The memory that keeps the first `over` (the card over itself) from replacing the pick-up sentence lives in an announcer the board creates once (`useState`), not in the memoised object, so a rebuild mid-drag repeats no sentence (AGENTS.md #10), and nothing reads a ref during render.
- Nothing else on the board changes: drag behaviour, sensors, collision detection, the screen-reader instructions and the existing strings. Nothing is added to `@object-ui/plugin-kanban`'s entry, so Clause-② is no.

## Before and after, in the browser

Showcase task board (`/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task/view/showcase_task.board`), backend objectstack `66d456d01` `examples/app-showcase` with `--fresh`, console from this branch's worktree (vite dev). Chromium `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`, signed in as the seeded admin, screenshot before every read of `#DndLiveRegion-*`. Mouse drag of the first card: pick-up, over the next column's first card, over the empty lower part of the column after it, then Escape.

| moment | `main` `3288c12` (en and zh read the same) | this branch, en | this branch, zh |
|---|---|---|---|
| pick-up | `Draggable item R-rXBJewHjmPzNfF was moved over droppable area R-rXBJewHjmPzNfF.` | `Picked up Content backlog in Backlog.` | `已拿起 Content backlog，当前在 待规划。` |
| over a card | `Draggable item R-rXBJewHjmPzNfF was moved over droppable area Jm0z0X6NWsbqyfAH.` | `Moving Content backlog over SEO migration plan in To Do.` | `Content backlog 正移到 待办 中的 SEO migration plan 上。` |
| over a column's empty area | `Draggable item R-rXBJewHjmPzNfF was moved over droppable area in_progress.` | `Moving Content backlog over In Progress.` | `Content backlog 正移到 进行中。` |
| Escape | `Dragging was cancelled. Draggable item R-rXBJewHjmPzNfF was dropped.` | `Cancelled moving Content backlog. It stays in Backlog.` | `已取消拖动。Content backlog 仍在 待规划。` |

One real drop, in the temporary database only: over "SEO migration plan" and released, the region read `Moved Content backlog to To Do.` and the card was in To Do afterwards.

**The PM's hypothesis 1, measured:** the over target is the dragged card itself at pick-up, a neighbouring card's record id while the pointer is over cards, and the column's option value (`in_progress`) over a column's empty area. The sentence names whichever it is: the card by its title (with its column), the column by its label.

**Swimlanes:** the swimlane layout renders inside the same, single `DndContext`, so the same helper covers it. Its lane cells are not droppable (only cards are), which is unchanged; a pointer over no card reads "It is not over a column."

## Pins and ablations

`packages/plugin-kanban/src/__tests__/dndAnnouncements-12716.test.tsx` drives the real board, the real `DndContext`, sensors and handlers with real pointer events, and reads the real live region. Only `collisionDetection` is replaced by a band geometry (the test DOM measures every box as zero), the form designer's instrument. Five cases: pick-up / over a card / over a column / over nothing / cancel (en); a cross-column drop; a drop in its own column; the same drag in zh; a blank-titled card and column. Every drop carries a control: the move the board hands `onCardMove`.

Each ablation was run through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (objectstack), which verified the anchor hit and the blob changed, then restored and verified `git diff HEAD` empty:

| ablation (on head `56be1f6`) | result |
|---|---|
| A: delete `accessibility={dndAccessibility}` from the board | 5 of 5 red, each reading dnd-kit's id sentence, e.g. `Draggable item gZguOoFVfxm_pSPG was moved over droppable area gZguOoFVfxm_pSPG.` |
| B: delete the zh `kanban.dnd.start` value | 1 of 5 red, only the zh case: expected `已拿起 Content backlog，当前在 To Do。`, received `Picked up Content backlog in To Do.` |
| C: make the place memory always answer `undefined` (its `get`) | 3 of 5 red: the first `over` replaces the pick-up sentence, e.g. received `Moving Content backlog over To Do.` |

Restored: 5 of 5 green.

## Local gates (on head `56be1f6`)

- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter "@object-ui/plugin-kanban..." run build`: exit 0; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-kanban run build` re-run on the final head: exit 0.
- The console's closure, which includes the board: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter "@object-ui/console..." run build`: exit 0 (`@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console` among the packages built).
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-kanban/ packages/i18n/`: exit 0, 155 files passed, 1816 tests passed, 13 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-kanban run type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check`: exit 0 each (the script name echoed; `tsconfig.test.json` lists the new test and helper).
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the 13 changed source files: exit 0, no new warning (the one warning is the existing `rules as any` in `getCardStyles`).
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0. `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: exit 0, 0 new citations.
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys`: exit 0 (every defaults-table row matches its en value, interpolation parity holds). `pnpm check:i18n-drift`: exit 0 (9 keys added, 0 en values changed). `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys`: exit 0, no `kanban.dnd` key listed.

## Acceptance notes

Found while measuring, left alone here:

- **The screen-reader instructions promise a keyboard drag the board does not have.** Every card's `aria-describedby` points at dnd-kit's default English instructions ("To pick up a draggable item, press the space bar. While dragging, use the arrow keys…"). The board's sensors are pointer and touch only. Measured in the browser: Space on a focused card starts no drag (the region did not change, no card reported `aria-pressed`). The text is English under zh too. The README's features list says the same: "Built on @dnd-kit with keyboard navigation support". Reported to the seat for filing.
- **Interpolated aria-labels on the board read in English under zh.** Each lane's list is named by a template with the English word "cards" (measured on the zh showcase board: `待规划 cards`); the swimlane cells and the drag overlay ("Dragging" plus the title) have the same shape. This is objectui#12145's family; that census states that interpolating templates are outside its instrument. Reported to the seat, not filed separately.
- **No `onDragCancel` handler on the board.** A cancelled drag leaves `activeCard` set and does not call the ObjectUI drag bridge's `endDrag()`. Read in source only; no reachable symptom measured. Noted, not filed.
